Poemecia

2016
Bioart installation: cultured microorganisms, microscope, custom software, live Twitter feed

Poemecia begins with single-celled organisms cultured from soil collected just outside the NSA’s Utah Data Center in Bluffdale, isolated and left to reproduce for ten weeks. Under a microscope, the colony is filmed over a layer of the 750 surveillance keywords behind NSA Haiku Generator, drawn from a FOIA request to the Department of Homeland Security. As the microorganisms move, they trigger the words beneath them, and once enough are triggered to form a haiku, it is tweeted live from @NSAHaiku: “Law enforcement Sphinx / utopia credit card / World Domination.” Same form, same account as the generator, only now the poet is biology rather than a script.
